cards.card_text: Grape juice and raisins are still fine for a Nazirite, since there's no wine in them.
cards.verse_text: He must not drink vinegar made from wine or strong drink, and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins.
cards.snippet: …he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins.

cards.card_text: Abigail hurries and loads donkeys with two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five butchered sheep, roasted grain, a hundred clusters of raisins and two hundred cakes of figs.
cards.verse_text: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five butchered sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs.
cards.snippet: …five butchered sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs.

cards.card_text: They give him water, a piece of a fig cake and two clusters of raisins, and he eats and is revived.
cards.verse_text: They gave the man water to drink and food to eat— a piece of a fig cake and two clusters of raisins.
cards.snippet: …to eat— a piece of a fig cake and two clusters of raisins.

cards.card_text: Then David hands every man and woman in the crowd a loaf of bread, a date cake and a raisin cake, and everybody heads home.
cards.verse_text: Then he distributed to every man and woman among the multitude of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
cards.snippet: …multitude of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.

cards.card_text: And Ziba packed BIG: two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits and a skin of wine.
cards.verse_text: He had a pair of saddled donkeys loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits, and a skin of wine.
cards.snippet: …donkeys loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred clusters of raisins, a hundred summer fruits, and a skin of wine.

cards.card_text: Then neighbors come from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun and Naphtali, bringing flour, fig cakes, raisin cakes, wine, oil, oxen and sheep on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen.
cards.verse_text: And their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen—abundant supplies of flour, fig cakes and raisin cakes, wine and oil, oxen and sheep.
cards.snippet: …on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen—abundant supplies of flour, fig cakes and raisin cakes, wine and oil, oxen and sheep.

cards.card_text: Then David starts handing out food: a loaf of bread, a date cake and a raisin cake.
cards.verse_text: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
cards.snippet: …woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.

cards.card_text: David hands out the bread, date cake and raisin cake only to the Levites who carried the ark.
cards.verse_text: Then he distributed to every man and woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.
cards.snippet: …woman of Israel a loaf of bread, a date cake, and a raisin cake.

cards.card_text: She asks to be sustained with raisins and refreshed with apples.
cards.verse_text: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.
cards.snippet: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.

cards.card_text: The LORD even says the Israelites love to offer raisin cakes to idols.
cards.verse_text: Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love to offer raisin cakes to idols.” So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
cards.snippet: …the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love to offer raisin cakes to idols.” So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver…
